items.title: Catalytic branching programs trade polynomial register space for exponential-time grouping costs
items.author: James Cook; Ian Mertz
items.source_version: Official CCC2022 complete published version,2022-07-11; formal main time-space tradeoffsTheorems11/15 with full Sections2–3.3
items.difficulty_reason: The authors re-express a Boolean polynomial in unknown catalytic register values, load selected monomials transparently, and use cyclic Gray-code scheduling to balance the number of stored monomials against query time; a degree-sensitive refinement preserves the same invariant.
